market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. CPI reacceleration + oil at $108 + yield spike create headwinds. S&P 500 below 50-day MA signals continued pressure. Fed 25bps hike likely. Expect 5-8% equity volatility. Oil may test $115 if Houthi escalation continues. Crypto likely to test $70K support.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Defense spending, AI infrastructure capex, and freight recovery provide structural growth. However, sustained 7%+ mortgage rates and $6 diesel cap consumer spending. Treasury credibility question is the key macro risk; if GPIF/China shift reserves, USD weakens long-term. Energy transition (battery storage, nat-gas) offers 3-5 year tailwinds.
